create.name: Catherine Liggett
create.bio:
Catherine Liggett is a shadow work guide, writer and podcaster who lives in Shoreline, just north of Seattle. Her central theme is learning to stay with strong feelings in the body instead of thinking about them or pushing them away. Before this work she taught German at Oregon State University, and she came to it through years of her own inner work, dance and yoga teaching, and Holy Fire Reiki training. She credits a Tara Brach retreat in her teens, the West African teachers Malidoma and Sobonfu Somé, and mentors in ancestral and spiritual practice as lasting influences, and she sees emotional life as tied to the body, family lines, community and the wider world.

At the heart of her teaching is a four-step practice she calls F.A.C.E., used to meet difficult inner parts with warmth, and much of her work touches on the inner child, the inner mother and old patterns in relationships. She no longer sees private clients, and now teaches through a pay-what-you-can audio course, a free guided practice and short guidebook, many years of free talks on YouTube, and The Tender Revolution podcast. Her Insight Timer page carries guided shadow work, recorded live sessions and courses. North Atlantic Books plans to publish her book on emotion, All the Feels, in 2028.

courses.title: Hold Yourself With Radical Love
courses.description: A self-paced audio course of ten sessions, each between 13 and 35 minutes, that can be streamed or downloaded. It teaches her four-step F.A.C.E. practice for turning a harsh inner voice into a kinder one and for meeting avoided parts of yourself with care. The same course is also on Insight Timer.
courses.price: Pay what you can (suggested $20, $40 or $70+ USD)

free_resources.title: Catherine Liggett on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided shadow work practices, talks and recordings of her live sessions, along with her courses. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Soften Your Barriers to Love
free_resources.description: A free guided shadow work practice of about twenty minutes, exploring what gets in the way of receiving love. It is sent by email when you join her list.

free_resources.title: How to Meet Yourself with Radical Love
free_resources.description: A free 19-page PDF guide that walks through her F.A.C.E. approach to shadow work one step at a time. You receive it by joining her email list.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 12.9k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram @catherinesfeelings 1,720 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube @catherineliggetthealing 1.21K subscribers (channel page); Facebook shadowworkwithcatherine 897 (og:description); TikTok @catherinesfeelings shows 1 follower → ~16.7k total → local_hero
flags: Brands herself as 'Holistic Mental Health' (site title also says 'Somatic Trauma Healing') and her home page speaks of moving people out of anxiety and depression; the plan keeps only the shadow work, emotion and spiritual side, and a human may want to judge the fit under the health-claim rule.
Email is info@ (a general inbox on her own domain), published on her contact page.

She no longer offers 1:1 sessions; the 'certification program' in the leads is not on her site (a third-party directory mentions an older 'Becoming Bold' / Empathic Witnessing programme from 2024), so it is not listed.
Only one paid offering: Hold Yourself With Radical Love (also on Insight Timer as a 10-day course; listed once, via her own Kajabi page).
Her YouTube videos are four to eight years old; a 2022 video says 'Where to Find Me Now', so the channel is no longer active.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
